message.content: {"8": {"original": "Police told Mr. Svartholm they were not obligated to provide a public defender, ", "rephrased": "The Swedish National Criminal Police informed the detained web host, Gottfrid Svartholm, that he was not entitled to a public defender because the specific charge he faced did not carry a potential prison sentence, a legal justification used to deny him legal representation during the interrogation phase of the raid on The Pirate Bay and associated servers.", "summary": "Swedish police denied a detained web host a public defender by citing the non-custodial nature of his specific charge."}}
